Workshop 3 · Practice problems

Guess the next word

Work these out by hand, without running code, the way the exam works. Total 30 marks. Fractions are fine as answers; you don't need a calculator.

Print

Problems 1 to 7 use these four tiny sentences:

<s> the fan is noisy </s>
<s> the fan is quiet </s>
<s> the dryer is noisy </s>
<s> the dryer works </s>
  1. [2]

    Ignore <s> and </s> for this problem. (a) How many words are there in the four sentences, and how many different words? (b) Using a unigram model (no context), what are P(the) and P(is)?

  2. [3]

    Now include the start and end marks. List every bigram (pair of neighbouring words) that appears, with how many times it appears.

  3. [3]

    Work out: (a) P(fan | the) (b) P(noisy | is) (c) P(works | dryer) (d) P(</s> | works) (e) P(quiet | fan)

  4. [3]

    Work out the probability of each sentence with the bigram model, showing each step:
    (a) the dryer is quiet   (b) the fan works

  5. [2]

    Explain why the answer to 4(b) is a problem for a phone keyboard, and name the fix.

  6. [4]

    Use add-one smoothing. The possible next words are the, fan, dryer, is, noisy, quiet, works and </s>, so V = 8.
    (a) P(works | fan) (b) P(is | fan) (c) P(noisy | is) (d) Compare (b) with the answer without smoothing. Why did it change?

  7. [3]

    With add-one smoothing (V = 8), work out the probability of the fan works. Leave your answer as a fraction.

  8. [3]

    Two models read the same four-word test sentence. Model A gives the real words the probabilities ¼, ¼, ½ and ⅛. Model B gives them ½, ½, ½ and ½.
    (a) Work out the perplexity of each model. (b) Which model is better, and what does the number mean in words?

  9. [3]

    A student picks the add-k value k by measuring perplexity on the same sentences the model was trained on. (a) Which k will they find is best, and why? (b) What should they do instead, and why?

  10. [2]

    A trigram model looks at the two words before, instead of one. Give one advantage and one disadvantage compared with a bigram model.

  11. [2]

    An Indian bank wants word suggestions in its customer chat. A vendor offers a bigram model trained on product reviews from a US shopping site. Give two reasons this model would do badly, and what you would ask for instead.

Answers will be released on the Workshop 3 page after class.
